INSERT INTO user_privacy_settings (user_id, dm_policy, call_policy, accept_friend_requests, show_local_time, updated_at)
            VALUES ($1, COALESCE($2, 'friends'), COALESCE($3, 'friends'), COALESCE($4, true), COALESCE($5, false), now())
            ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
                SET dm_policy = COALESCE($2, user_privacy_settings.dm_policy),
                    call_policy = COALESCE($3, user_privacy_settings.call_policy),
                    accept_friend_requests = COALESCE($4, user_privacy_settings.accept_friend_requests),
                    show_local_time = COALESCE($5, user_privacy_settings.show_local_time),
                    updated_at = now()
            RETURNING dm_policy, call_policy, accept_friend_requests, show_local_time
